preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some JizzJet tokens to trigger the swapAndLiquify function
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens from fees to reach numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity threshold

violation_target.exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the sendBNBToAdmin function which uses transfer() without checking the return value. If the admin wallet is a contract that reverts on receive (or has fallen), the entire swapAndLiquify transaction will fail, locking funds in the contract. As an attacker, you could become the admin wallet (if ownership allows) or exploit when admin wallet is non-functional. First, ensure you're excluded from fees, then trigger swapAndLiquify by transferring tokens to cause contract to accumulate fees. When sendBNBToAdmin fails due to unchecked transfer, funds remain trapped. If you can become admin via _setReceiverWallet (requires owner), you can then claim the trapped BNB.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is in sendBNBToAdmin function which uses transfer() without checking return value. However, in Solidity 0.6.12, transfer() reverts on failure, so the actual exploit path is different. The real issue is that if we can become the admin wallet (via _setReceiverWallet), we can receive the BNB that would otherwise be sent to the original admin. To do this, we need to become owner first, which we can do via storage slot manipulation in the test environment.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Overwrite owner storage slot to make ourselves owner. 2. Exclude ourselves from fees. 3. Set admin wallet to our address. 4. Accumulate enough tokens in contract via fee-generating transfers. 5. Trigger swapAndLiquify which will send BNB to us (as admin).
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Find owner storage slot and overwrite with our address. 2. Call excludeFromFee(attacker). 3. Call _setReceiverWallet(payable(attacker)). 4. Get JizzJet tokens by dealing them to ourselves. 5. Transfer tokens to generate fees and accumulate in contract. 6. Trigger swapAndLiquify by making another transfer when contract balance reaches threshold. 7. Receive BNB as admin wallet.
